title: Languages contained in the all-ones language
statement: For every language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet, $L$ is contained in the language of all-ones words if and only if every word in $L$ consists entirely of true bits; equivalently, each such word is a list of $n$ true bits for some $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
